subject: The tunnel terminal lines, the connect dialog text, the demo USDC trustline step, an offer and its cancellation, and declined 1Password prompts
operator: The maintainer approved or declined each 1Password prompt. An agent drove the local demo page in Chrome.

install.kind: A release walleterm binary built with make build in the worktree (walleterm 0.2.0-16-g977fd19). The tunnel and the demo used ports 18787 and 18788. The page and the bridge used loopback origins.

terminal_checks.observed: The code expires at 5:21 PM (in 5 minutes). It works once. The block says to enter the URL and code in the website or to scan with its Scan tunnel button.

Five lines 'Incorrect connection code from https://probe.example (attempt N of 5).', then a block 'Too many incorrect codes. New connections pause until 5:17 PM (in 1 minute). Then use this new code.'
HTTP 403 with access-control-allow-origin: http://probe.example and 'Serve the website over HTTPS. Plain HTTP works only on localhost and 127.0.0.1.'
One line without a QR code: 'The previous code expired. Enter code <new code> with <tunnel URL>. It expires at 5:26 PM (in 5 minutes).'
'Connected http://127.0.0.1:18788. Wallet scope: available, wallet changes allowed.' then a block 'The code was used. Use this new code for the next website.'

dialog_checks.observed: Next, you choose one active wallet. This website can then switch among all listed wallets.
The walleterm tunnel command prints the Tunnel URL and the Connection code. The code works once and expires after 5 minutes.
aria-invalid true, Continue disabled, 'Use the Tunnel URL exactly as walleterm tunnel prints it. It starts with https:// and has no path.'
This website can switch among all listed wallets. Walleterm signs each request from this website. 1Password can ask you to approve. The connection lasts one hour.

transactions.page_after: The USDC trustline is on testnet. You can place the offer now. The card then showed 'The USDC trustline is ready.', the Circle faucet line, and an enabled Offer.

transactions.operation: manageSellOffer selling XLM buying USDC:GBBD47…ZLLFLA5 amount 0.1000000 price 10 offerId 0

signatures_not_submitted.note: Planned as the declined prompt. 1Password reused the earlier approval and showed no prompt, so it signed. The page cleared it without submission. Horizon returns 404 for this hash.

findings: The message blames --vault when the person canceled the prompt.
The tunnel printed no line for a request that ended before signing.

refusals.terminal: 1Password did not sign d26b1022… (account GBMU6VU…, sequence 20897184853524522) for http://127.0.0.1:18788. You declined the prompt, or 1Password refused the request.

limits: The page used the loopback bridge, not the Cloudflare URL.
The Cloudflare 524 limit was measured by the bridge agent with a local slow server, not with a slow vault lookup.
The spent-code dialog fix (after the follow-up run) has unit tests only.
